Don-Jo KP-11x41-605, 11 x 41 Polished Brass Kickplate

Made of .050" thick high quality solid brass for longevity. Packaged with matching brass mounting screws for easy installation. Finished in lacquered polished brass.

Specifications of the Solid Brass KickPlate:

  • Material: Solid Brass
  • Finish: Polished Brass Finish
  • Plate Width: 11"
  • Length: 41"
  • Plate Thickness: .050" (1.2 mm)
  • Packaged With Matching Brass Mounting Screws

Sold Individually
